english: I know. I helped get the cows back in, remember?
I know. It's causing my circadian arrhythmia, all that clattering of armor.
I know. Just...leave it to me. You and the commander withdraw. I'll signal the ghostfire.
I left in such a rush that it got left behind on the laboratory counter. I have its blueprints among my records. I'll make another.
I like that idea. Let's go inside.
I like the wizards and their little words. "Wayfinder" is more exciting.
I like this city's cutthroat attitude, but not so much when I get the losing end of the deal.
I like to keep an eye on my husband. There are dangerous things in the lake.
I like you.
I like your pluck, little one, but this shop is for norn. I can't help you.
I look forward to seeing it completed.
I lost some very valuable merchandise in the crash.
I love seeing the Spirit Halls every day.
I love the sulfurous aroma of the Fire Islands. (sniffs) Ahhh.
I love things from Divinity's Reach!
I love this place. The long, low corridors, the amazing gold work. It's gorgeous.
I love traveling. If it weren't so dangerous, I'd do it more often.
I made this sacrifice so that my family may live.
I manage harvesting operations for Ojon's lumber mill west of here. We're doing all we can to keep up with the demand for lumber to support the Seraph's war effort.
I managed to finally get detailed ley readings from the map and determined...well...
I may be able to find something.
I may go take a look.
I may not have much of a moral compass, but I know enough not to sell when my allies are fighting for their lives. If we survive, talk to me later.
I mean, there's no way anyone could come close to rivaling the size of King Joko's army.
I mean, we did it! I had no doubts!
I mean... I may have occasionally experienced mild heart arrhythmia when we were working together...
I mean—oh, never mind. Get a bell.
I merely go where I'm needed.
I met someone who says you see Caudecus often.
I met you.
I might go to Lion's Arch and ask. Thanks.
I might have the free time to do a little sparring.
I might try again later.
I might. I'm not sure yet...
I mourn your loss.
I must be off. Glad to have met you.
I must go, Blessed Source. I'll return when I can.
I must go, my lady. Enjoy your stay.
I must have eaten a bad termite. It tasted okay at the time, but now I wonder.
I must prepare for my journey to the temple.
I must really make amends before my body comes to court.
I must say, seeing a friendly face is a real comfort, especially with all of our troubles lately. The dredge have been making life difficult for us.
I must...remember every feeling, every smell, every taste... I will report it all later.
I nearly got my eye poked out today. That would have been a disaster.
I need a bigger challenge.
I need a healer!
I need a plan, we need more supplies.
I need help purifying these poor owls, abused by the Sons of Svanir. Could you stay by me, please?
I need help reaching the rally point.
I need help recovering belongings lost in our crash, particularly the fragments of our crystals. Please, can you help me?
I need help! Please. Won't you help me? It's my partner. He's been captured by the Inquest. I'm so worried. There's no telling what they're doing to him.
I need help, brethren!
I need it! I could really use some good reading material.
I need medical supplies!
I need more soldiers here, now!
I need solutions, not excuses, soldier.
I need some alone time.
I need some help recovering some scrap metal from above us!
I need some supplies.
I need to acquire chatoyant items.
I need to find my way to a crafting area.
I need to find my way to an asura gate.
I need to get clear of this.
I need to get him out of that office...
I need to get up to the top of that cliff... Maybe with a glider? Might be able to build a fire and catch an updraft, but...
I need to study. After that, I'll probably do a little stargazing.
I need to think about it before I decide.
I need to think about this, now that the danger has passed.
I need you to shadow Logan Thackeray. Stay with him, but don't let him see you. Keep him alive. He still has a role to play. —E
I need your help, brothers!
I need...time. There are rituals to perform. And Garm... Spirits, I don't even know if he was with her during the crash.
I negotiated my way out. Unlike you, I realized how pointless and destructive my chosen course was, so I changed it.
I never believed an outsider could stand against Michin. It's not our usual practice to include non-hylek, but with the krait weakening our kind, we had no choice.
I never learned to swim. There isn't much cause for it in the Black Citadel. But, if you go over and look around, I guarantee that something worthwhile will happen.
I notice there aren't many sylvari around this camp.
I now realize the problem; I forgot the wine!
I only found it recently myself, while wandering. It's breathtaking. I can only imagine the history that must have happened here...
I only see one flake here. See ya.
I only sell to those knowledgeable on the subject of ley rifts.
I only want to kill the dragon! Its death might kill me—the entire sylvari people—but that's better than living in its grasp!
I order each and every one of you detained!
I plan to make a difference here.
I plan to write a novel accounting this grand adventure.
I preach until I'm blue in the mouth. Nothing.
I prefer tending to crops over hunting. I feel bad when prey flees from me. I'd much rather be in the garden.
I prefer to think of my greatness not as an honor for me, but as an inspiration for anyone not me.
I probably shouldn't do this, but you've earned my trust. I've got a batch of new rifles that we're about to ship to Rata Sum. You can have one of the first models for a modest fee, if you'd like.

I promise you wealth, titles, and land for your service in returning the crown of Kryta to where it belongs—on the head of the Confessor of White Mantle! So what will it be: Throw your life away at the feet of a dragon like the foolhardy Pact? Or return to my good graces, and be rewarded with wealth and power?
I promise you, I'll keep your husband safe!
I provide whatever counsel and comfort I can to the refugees, travelers, and Cavaliers at this outpost. Other than ministry, I'm afraid all I can offer is my knowledge of the sand sea.
I put in for the Western Ward route. That place is trouble, and trouble means I won't be bored.
I regret your loss.
I reign supreme.
I reject Mordremoth!
I remember it like it was yesterday. You were there, right? The battle for Lion's Arch.
I remember waaay back when Kormir was a Sunspear... I wish those soldiers had survived the years.
I remember when I first got here... For weeks all I wanted to do was curl up and die.
I remember when I first joined the Vigil. General Soulkeeper told me our work would likely never be done—
I said you needed to catch a Charradis Firefly. Get going!
I said you needed to catch a Charradis Fly Swarm. Get going!
I said you needed to catch a Charradis Wasp. Get going!
I saw my great-great-great-aunt Asha recently.
I saw that! Seems your petty palate is already overwhelmed!
I saw you at dinner last night. How can you eat that stuff?
I say it's time we take care of ours.
I see Tholin's influence in your words. I'd better return to my post.
I see in your heart that you have lost someone to Zhaitan. Someone named...Forgal. He is waiting for you now, beneath the dragon's wings...
I see in your heart that you have lost someone to Zhaitan. Someone named...Tybalt. He is waiting for you now, beneath the dragon's wings...
I see it. You're right, it's like the overseer we fought before, but...different.
I see that. Good talking with you.
I see the Zephyrites are no strangers to the appeal of a well-kept home. I've adapted a number of decorations for your homestead—for a small trade, you can bring some souvenirs back home.
I see the wisdom in that. Good-bye.
I see them! Invasion is imminent. Someone do something! Now would be good!
I see you clearly now, Nenah. You worshiped Kormir, and were a teacher.
I see you've already figured out the art of marching single file. Excellent.
I see you've found my workshop. Something I can do for you?
I see you've had a few chips knocked out of you, %str1%. You continue on your Wyld Hunt, I presume?
I see you...
I see!
I see, and what else?
I see, thanks for the lead.
I see. Curiosity killed the cat, you know?
I see. Good luck with your research.
I see. Good luck with your studies.
I see. I'll be on the lookout.
I see. Well then, you'd better come with me. I think I know where one of her offspring is. We should hurry.
I see. Well, I appreciate how...diligently you perform your duty.
I see. You'd better watch your back then.
I sense a trendsetter.
I should check in with Narcisse. Maybe she can help.
I should check this Meatoberfest out. Thanks.
I should flee, but they'll hunt me.
I should gather a bouquet of flowers in case Lord Joko shows up.
I should go find out what she's up to. Kisha, you're in charge until I return.
I should go...
I should look around.
I should pat myself on the back. This one might be my best crafted portal spike yet.
I should probably learn how to fight. I hate violence, but things keep attacking us.
I should probably leave now, before I tear up.
I should touch base with Councillor Ludo. Might know something.
I should try activating the other lightning rods.
I should try some of that!
I should've changed. What if I get bloodstains on these new clothes?
I smell inferiors.
I smell weakness.
I solved the puzzle.
I sometimes worry about giving aid to those who flee north. What if losing those supplies makes us miss our quota?
I spoke with one business owner in Kaineng who applauded the decision to reopen, eager to see an influx of tourism.
I still don't get it. Why would the Flame Legion play with tar? Isn't that dangerous?
I still have time left on my rental.
I still intend on living!
I still long for those gentle waterfalls, windy cliffs, and of course, my tree. Its lofty branches and mushroom ledges brought me so close to the sun's rays.
I still need a rescue. Oh, gods, I hope they don't just forget about me...
I strongly suggest you run.
I suggest we slip in quietly and cut throats until there aren't enough of them left to spring it.
I summoned you to relay a missive from your sire, Argus Foolkiller.
I suppose I could go do that.
I suppose I could sell you some.
I suppose it is true that the most immediate threat is gone...
I suppose no one in power can stop her if they're sloshed in her sitting room. Clever woman. Strange. But clever.
I suppose the sylvari deserve the benefit of the doubt.
I suppose you're right. Let's get it done.
I suppose. But if we can convince them to reconsider and join us, it'd surely turn the tide in our favor.
I surrender! I need to go.
I suspect that Yerkk wants to find a way to increase his own intelligence. If he can figure out why the size of the population equates to the size of their IQs, maybe he can bottle it.
I swear, if I could recycle this parental unit, I would.
I swore to myself I'd never go back to jail, and yet...here we are. This one's for you, Serentine.
I take no joy in this.
I take no pleasure in bloodshed.
I talk a big game, but I didn't really wanna fight on two fronts!
I taste salt. Do you taste salt?
I taste...danger.
I tell you, the generosity of the Seraph is heartening. I'd thought I could hold out against the centaurs... Here, at least, I feel somewhat safe.
I think I ate a bad oyster. Did they come all the way from Amnoon?
I think I felt that one.
I think I get it. Only one way to know for sure.
I think I hit my head during the crash. I've got a splitting headache right now.
I think I just opened a door somewhere.
I think I love you.
I think I'd better go now.
I think I'll go check to see how everyone's doing.
I think I'll have a go at it.
I think I'll just make an egress of expedience.
I think I'll save my ectoplasm for other things.
I think I'll start working on my own effigy.
I think I'll visit the Garden after this.
I think I'm going to take a look around now.
I think all of Hoelbrak has come out.
I think it's high time we returned home, don't you?
I think it's time we consider going home.
I think of Zelechor Hot Springs here as my romantic getaway in the mountains. Or I would, if I could find some romance...
I think one more ought to do it. Just a bit further now.
I think that crash dislocated my shoulder.
I think that's all of our people. Shall we head home now?
I think the more appropriate question would be what don't we teach here? Our lessons cover everything Eternal Alchemical. You would be hardpressed to find a better precollege than Splorg Metamystics.
I think the odds are in our favor. Forty-one percent in our favor, in fact.
I think the teacher's brain was replaced with a junundu's brain.
I think they're going to send a team down to try and rescue them.
I think this is taking a toll on her mentally more than anything else.
I think this is what you need.
I think we've used all the scrap we have.
I think whatever's powering this city is connected to those pylons.
I think you House Ingene guys could use a little more sun.
I think you'll find my argument persausive.
I thought I smelled black powder on the breeze. We should link up with them.
I thought myself weak, but we all have the ability to protect the things we care for. %str1%, I may be able to grant you a boon, in memory of Owl.
I thought skritt kept everything?
I thought that dredge leader would put up more of a fight. How embarrassing, dying so easily. We should revive him and give him another chance to fight. Then he can die with honor.
I thought we had our hands full with Caudecus and Lazarus, but sure, I think we can squeeze in a quick trip to the Shiverpeaks to take down a dragon.
I thought we had our hands full with Caudecus and Lazarus, but sure, we can squeeze in a quick trip to take down a dragon.
I thought we had our hands full with Caudecus and Lazarus, but sure, we can squeeze in a quick trip to the Shiverpeaks to take down a dragon.
I took a class. Let's roll.
I totally get it.
I traveled all over Tyria to find them all. It took quite a lot of effort, but I'd say it's worth it.
I traveled with the Sunspears to this place. We fought the Awakened together as allies. But when Joko diverted the Elon, though the waters could not harm me, my friends all drowned.
I tried skritt rations once. Never again.
I trust that you now see that allying with the Sunspears was a mistake. If we can take down a god, what hope does that sect have against us?
I underestimated these squeaking beasts. You were right, Crusader. No matter how small, every set of hands—or scrabbly claws—is important to our cause.
I understand the desire for increased laboratory defenses, but our first priority is research, not armored lab slippers.
I understand, but...maybe don't take it out on the one person who's willing to put up with you?
I understand. Anything you can spare. You're lifesavers.
I understand. I don't blame you.
I understand. I don't know why it chose me, but I will do my best.
I understand. I'm in the Priory, too.
I use this harsh place to hone my skills, like using coarse stone to sharpen a blade. I enjoyed my solitude before the crash, but I will admit the sight of new faces has been refreshing.
I used to know a spell that could teleport us out of here.
I want everything documented! And I mean everything!
I want the grawl to think their god has forsaken them. Those superstitious fools will run away from here and camp somewhere else. It's a clever plan worthy of Raven, if I do say so myself.
I want to access the guild bank.
I want to become stronger, but I haven't tamed a beast. I cannot be this weak.
I want to change where my commendations go.
I want to change which legion my commendations go to.
I want to get medicine to an injured soldier standing watch.
I want to go to the Crown Pavilion.
I want to hear about a different specialization.
I want to hear about the adventurers—mesmers, engineers, and rangers.
I want to hear about the adventurers—thieves, engineers, and rangers.
I want to impress my friends and family, to show how them how refined I've become studying art and manners here at the academy!
I want to join them. Please direct me to the Stone of Hazaan.
I want to race.
I want to return to my normal form.
I want to travel to a pet sanctuary.
I wanted to finish it!
I warned you not to breathe too many of the spores.
I was a sculptor. I dedicated my life to creating more and more beautiful statues of Joko. Halfway through my masterpiece, he died. How will I ever finish it now?
I was called by the Pale Mother. I believe she senses the danger that lies before us, and wishes me to organize the forces of order to combat this threat.
I was desperate, and turned to thievery to pay my creditors.
I was drawn to you. Your loyalty to our lord Balthazar inspired me to join your battalion of Eternals. And now, I have been chosen by our lord to be his herald, and I must give you orders.
I was exhausted, but Lord Beetlestone was impressed by how I handled myself. He got me reassigned here.
I was here before you, and though it's none of your business, I'm in the midst of an important mission.
I was hoping to get a ride back to the Pact base camp, actually.
I was in the Priory for a long while. The Wizard's Tower had always fascinated us, but...it frustrated me that we couldn't know more. We knew that something operated in Tyria's shadow, but what?
I was just thinking this place could use a skylight.

I was on a bug-cloud-tracking mission, and I came back to find them changed. They're not my tribe anymore. They're stronger, and I'm afraid they'll kill me if they find me. Or change me to be like them.

I was once stationed inside a fort that was under siege for four weeks. We held off the enemy with everything we had. The enemy got so desperate they started hurdling cattle over the walls of the fort.
I was right. That creature was horrible AND depressing.

I was there, you know. At the reactor. When it blew. I've never seen such horror in my life. Great balls of magic cascaded down upon us, spinning us around, up, and down. I was lucky. Others were less so.
I was told you might have something to help with the mech's defenses.
I was wary of starting a lab at a tengu outpost, but I must admit, they can supply some very unique research materials. Easy access to local test subjects has also been beneficial.
I was, uh...encouraged to come here by some charr. Then they confiscated my datapad.
I wasn't able to visit last time, but I'm glad I can see it now.
I wasn't expecting Xera to put up such a fight.
I wasn't expecting to see anyone else up here! Come to admire the view?
I wasn't sure Chief Timblin was cut out for this, but I've been pleasantly surprised.
I waved to the weird janitor guy today.
I went to check on Logan, but the doctors said he'd been discharged.
I will assist in any way that I can.
I will become a storm wizard! Summon water for the ship to sail! (grunt)
I will die to defend the Queen!
I will dispel the vines. That will surely attract their attention.
I will do my best, your Majesty. May Dwayna watch over us all.
I will find them and end their torment. Send aid if you can.
I will haunt your dreams.
I will help find rest of you, with help from friends. Oh. Must get friends!
I will judge you!
I will never bow to Mordremoth!
I will never get used to the heat.
I will not be swayed. Neither should you.
I will not give them up!
I will return to cut you down.
I will rise again by King Joko's hand. When I do, I will find you.
I will take you to a special place. Follow me, if you can.
I will. He speaks so highly of you—you should hear how he brags when your name comes up at the bar!
I will. I wish you well.
I will. This whole jungle will bleed and burn. But first...you all need to go. Let me say good-bye my way. The norn way.
I win, as expected.
I wish Aurene was taking a more active role. She's hesitating—and I'm not sure why.
I wish I had the nose of that hound.
I wish I'd met them.
I wish King Joko would return. It was so much better when he was running things.
I wish this guy would take a hint and let me soak in peace.
I wish to return to traveling throughout Tyria, discovering new places. But I must do what's right for my people, so personal aspirations may need to wait.
I wish we could've stayed with her, but I won't ever forgive Papa for what he did.
I wish we didn't have to do book reports.
I wish you and your people the best.
I wish you success. C'mon, Taimi. Let's go.
I won't be of much help either.
I won't be sacrificed to this witch hunt!
I won't believe he's dead until I see the body. I can't. He'll come back. I know he will.
I won't betray Tyria.
I won't come undone...
I won't die in vain...
I won't keep you from your rounds.
I won't let the camp fall. I owe the Priory too much. Stand with me!
I won't let them near you.
I won't let this all be for nothing. I'm ending this...now!
I won't mention it.
I won't pretend to understand how they work, but I won't complain.
I won't stand for this. I'd rather take my chances in the jungle!
I won't stay where I'm not wanted. Good riddance!
I won't. Carry on.
I wonder how Yao's holding up? I should give them a ring.
I wonder how large my statue will be. Such thoughts for later! More work awaits!
I wonder how strong a Branded creature really is.
I wonder if we could use wyverns as a power source? I must make a note of that.
I wonder when Palawa Joko will grace us with his presence.
I wonder who will win the Most Venturous Pupil this year.
I work for Braxa Scalehunter, keeping her devourer queens safe and healthy. I also help with the egg harvest.
I would appear to be in trouble, here.
I would give all my weapons for a blast of cold, dry air from the Shiverpeaks.
I would have carved them instead of the ice. Good-bye.
I would like to be able to count on you in a pinch, soldier.
I would like to see your inventory please, Gharr.
I would love to. It's a date!
I would never think of leaving. Why would you say that? We are friends, and friends do not abandon each other.
I would never...
I would tell you not to fear, but... (giggle)
I wouldn't get too close to those gates, if I were you!
I wouldn't sweat it. They'll rise up against us long before that happens.
I'd be able to let go of all this...grief. Mabon, Maguuma... But I'd leave almost everything of merit I've ever achieved.
I'd be careful. Choya like to burrow under the sand.
I'd be glad to. Let's go.
I'd be honored. Haven't seen Rox since Dragonfall—it'll be nice to catch up.
I'd bed down on a pile of hay if it got me away from those blasted bed bugs.
I'd bet my whiskers on it...well, on the Itzel, anyway. I'm not so sure about the big guy.
I'd better go. Be safe.
I'd expect this collection of ley line energy to draw out that thing.
I'd get them myself, but dangerous. Very dangerous indeed!
I'd give anything for a sandwich.
I'd just love to chat, but this foolhardy plan is about to explode in all our faces. I need to concentrate.
I'd keep me under your hat, for now. Get to know me a little before doing anything severe.
I'd like some time off for the festival.
I'd like to ask about a different legion.
I'd like to be your ally. Anything I can do to achieve that?
I'd like to believe we're living through a natural process, but—
I'd like to browse your inventory.
I'd like to expand my garden. How do I add more plots?
I'd like to go to the Labyrinthine Cliffs!
I'd like to join a raid encounter (Secrets of the Obscure).
I'd like to know more about the Pale Reavers.
I'd like to rent a jackal. (Pay 10 silver)
I'd like to rent a raptor. (Pay 10 silver)
I'd like to rent a skiff. (Pay 10 silver)
I'd like to rent a springer. (Pay 10 silver)
I'd like to use my PvP skills.
I'd like to use my WvW skills.
I'd love to learn more about this!
I'd love to visit with you, but I'm needed elsewhere. Maybe later?
I'd love to. Is there a cost?
I'd never admit it to his stupid face, but Smodur's prob'ly got the right idea. We can't just sit around.
I'd prefer you didn't.
I'd rather not, thanks.
I'd rather not. I'll stand guard out front. Make sure no one disrupts you.
I'd say I've gotten used to it, but there's no reason to lie. Legions, advance!
I'd say the gods answered my prayers, but... Forget it. Between camp and Priory tasks, I'm swamped. Help a scholar out?
I'd stay and help, but I have to get out of here.
I'd venture to say this lot fell in an attempt to retake the Foundry.
I'll allow your presence here, for a while.
I'll ask him.
I'll assist the messenger golem. Where do I go?
I'll be back. I promise.
I'll be sure to provide you all with a reward fitting such impressive work.
I'll bring you any cores I find.
I'll bury you in treasure!
I'll check back in later, then.
I'll check in with you later, soldier.
I'll check this out later.
I'll come back when I've unlocked the Nuhoch Proving mastery.
I'll crush your skull!
I'll deactivate armorsmith and become a chef.
I'll deactivate armorsmith and become an artificer.
I'll deactivate artificer and become a tailor.
I'll deactivate artificer and become an armorsmith.
I'll deactivate chef and become an armorsmith.
I'll deactivate huntsman and become an armorsmith.
I'll deactivate leatherworker and become an armorsmith.
I'll do it, Rox. You rest.
I'll do it. Rox, you rest.
I'll do my best, ma'am.
I'll do something, all right. I'll end this. For good.
I'll end you!
I'll escort you.
I'll figure it out. Give me one.
I'll find the keenest eyes among us and send them up.
I'll find the key and come back.
I'll find them.
I'll get you.
I'll give 1 gold.
I'll give 1 silver.
I'll give 10 silver.
I'll give 50 silver.
I'll give it a try!
I'll give you Rolic boys several things. You're lazy. You're out of shape. You're ugly. You smell. Should I keep going?
I'll give you Ventura girls one thing. You're fit.
I'll go with you.
I'll go with you. We can fight them together.
I'll go, too. I can keep an eye on Braham and the tribune can catch me up on how he got here.
I'll gut ye!
I'll have a drink.
I'll have more made from scrap. We'll use every bit we can scrounge.
I'll have nightmares about those Awakened for the rest of my life.
I'll have to find the next tablet if I want to know more.
I'll help you get home.
I'll help you. What would help most in securing this land?
I'll keep going, then, to preserve the memory of everything that was lost.
I'll keep my eyes open for any other flyers like this.
I'll keep my eyes open for you. Good-bye.
I'll keep searching.
I'll leave the collapsed tunnel alone.
I'll let you get back to your work, then.
I'll look around for him.
I'll look around for them.
I'll make sure she gets there. Which way did she go?
I'll make sure your field orders are delivered.
I'll mingle in a bit. I have something else to do first.
I'll miss her keen observations.
I'll need a hammer to help with construction. There may be one in the keep.
I'll never find my purpose in this trash heap.
I'll never forget what you did for us.
I'll never get my fill. Enjoy your day, my friend.
I'll reduce you to ashes!
I'll return when I have an unstable Kryptis motivation.
I'll return when I have enough.
I'll round up a group myself and send them your way.
I'll see for myself.
I'll see if I can get you some help.
I'll see what I can do for your friends. Just show me where to go.
I'll see what I can do. Farewell.
I'll see you on the field of battle at Kodash, Beastmarshal.
I'll send word to the tower.
I'll serve Palawa Joko someday.
I'll show them a thing or two.
I'll silence their weapons for you.
I'll sing your memory at Eventide's.
I'll slow down when I'm dead, but just a little. See you around, Habel.
I'll stand with you against them.
I'll stay, too. If something goes wrong...or Trahearne isn't what he seems to be...I'll be standing by.
I'll stop asking questions. Good-bye.
I'll take a look later.
I'll tear off their tails with my bare hands, I will!
I'll try Hamstrung. Even crippled, I won't be beaten.
I'll try not to. Good-bye.
I'll tussle them up!
I'll wager a month's pay that I can kill more than you!
I'll wait until that day, then.
I'll watch your kids. Go ahead and hunt.
I'll...crush...you...
